purpose: Face background layers behind separate rank, suit and court sprites

entries.name: Lucky
entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production playing-card FACE BACKGROUND layer for a retro pixel-art Bid Euchre game. Create ONE flat upright portrait rectangular texture, ratio 31:44, completely filling the entire image edge to edge. This is the substrate behind separately drawn ranks, pips and royal figures, NOT the decorative reverse side. Match a cohesive set of crisp chunky pixel-art material textures, clean low-resolution square clusters, restrained palette, no blur, no photorealism. Keep at least the central 65 percent very light and low-contrast to support dark black and red card markings; also keep top-left and bottom-right corners light and quiet for indices. Small-scale texture should not compete with markings. No card outline, no inset border, no rounded corners, no surrounding scene, no drop shadow, no perspective. Absolutely NO ranks, NO numerals, NO letters, NO words, NO playing-card suit symbols, NO central illustration, NO royal figures, NO card-back lattice or medallion. Opaque full canvas. Material design: Pale ivory-jade paper with restrained mint-green four-leaf clover impressions and a few tiny warm gold flecks concentrated near the outer edges; light uncluttered center.
